+ #### シェーダー統合実装
+ ```hlsl
+ // VRC Light Volumes関数
+ #if defined(VRC_LIGHT_VOLUMES_ENABLED)
+ float3 SampleVRCLightVolumes(float3 worldPos)
+ {
+     #if defined(VRC_LIGHT_VOLUMES_MOBILE)
+         // モバイル向け簡易版
+         float3 localPos = mul(_VRCLightVolumeWorldToLocal, float4(worldPos, 1.0)).xyz;
+         float3 volumeUV = localPos * 0.5 + 0.5;
+         float3 lightColor = tex3D(_VRCLightVolumeTexture, volumeUV).rgb;
+         return lightColor * _VRCLightVolumeTint.rgb * _VRCLightVolumeIntensity;
+     #else
+         // フル機能版
+         float3 localPos = mul(_VRCLightVolumeWorldToLocal, float4(worldPos, 1.0)).xyz;
+         float3 volumeUV = localPos * 0.5 + 0.5;
+         // ボリュームの範囲外なら影響なし
+         if (volumeUV.x < 0.0 || volumeUV.x > 1.0 || volumeUV.y < 0.0 || volumeUV.y > 1.0 || volumeUV.z < 0.0 || volumeUV.z > 1.0)
+             return float3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
+         float3 lightColor = tex3D(_VRCLightVolumeTexture, volumeUV).rgb;
+         // 距離による減衰
+         float distFactor = 1.0 - saturate(length(localPos) * _VRCLightVolumeDistanceFactor);
+         return lerp(float3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), lightColor * _VRCLightVolumeTint.rgb, _VRCLightVolumeIntensity * distFactor);
+     #endif
+ }
+ #endif
+ ```
+

+ #### パフォーマンス最適化
+ ```csharp
+ // 距離カリング
+ private void UpdateLightVolumes()
+ {
+     Vector3 cameraPos = mainCamera != null ? mainCamera.transform.position : Vector3.zero;
+     
+     foreach (var material in pcssMaterials)
+     {
+         var renderer = targetRenderers.FirstOrDefault(r => r.materials.Contains(material));
+         if (renderer != null)
+         {
+             float distance = Vector3.Distance(cameraPos, renderer.transform.position);
+             float distanceFactor = Mathf.Clamp01(1.0f - (distance / maxLightVolumeDistance));
+             material.SetFloat("_VRCLightVolumeDistanceFactor", distanceFactor);
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ ```

          /// <summary>
-         /// lilToonのバ�Eジョンを�E動検�E
+         /// 電源断保護機能の初期化
+         /// </summary>
+         private void InitializeEmergencyProtection()
+         {
+             sessionId = System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
+             lastCheckpoint = DateTime.Now;
+             
+             // シグナルハンドラーの設定
+             Application.quitting += OnApplicationQuitting;
+             
+             // 定期チェックポイントの開始
+             if (emergencySaveEnabled)
+             {
+                 InvokeRepeating(nameof(CreateCheckpoint), autoCheckpointInterval, autoCheckpointInterval);
+             }
+             
+             Debug.Log($"[Emergency Protection] Session {sessionId} initialized");
+         }
+         
+         /// <summary>
+         /// アプリケーション終了時の処理
+         /// </summary>
+         private void OnApplicationQuitting()
+         {
+             CreateEmergencyBackup();
+         }
+         
+         /// <summary>
+         /// 緊急バックアップの作成
+         /// </summary>
+         private void CreateEmergencyBackup()
+         {
+             try
+             {
+                 var backupData = new Dictionary<string, object>
+                 {
+                     {"sessionId", sessionId},
+                     {"timestamp", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss")},
+                     {"materials", managedMaterials.Select(m => m.name).ToArray()},
+                     {"settings", new Dictionary<string, object>
+                     {
+                         {"emergencySaveEnabled", emergencySaveEnabled},
+                         {"useVRCLightVolumes", useVRCLightVolumes},
+                         {"vrclvIntensity", vrclvIntensity}
+                     }}
+                 };
+                 
+                 string backupPath = $"EmergencyBackup_{sessionId}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.json";
+                 string jsonData = JsonUtility.ToJson(backupData, true);
+                 System.IO.File.WriteAllText(backupPath, jsonData);
+                 
+                 Debug.Log($"[Emergency Protection] Emergency backup created: {backupPath}");
+             }
+             catch (Exception ex)
+             {
+                 Debug.LogError($"[Emergency Protection] Failed to create emergency backup: {ex.Message}");
+             }
+         }
+         
+         /// <summary>
+         /// 定期チェックポイントの作成
+         /// </summary>
+         private void CreateCheckpoint()
+         {
+             if (!emergencySaveEnabled) return;
+             
+             try
+             {
+                 var checkpointData = new Dictionary<string, object>
+                 {
+                     {"sessionId", sessionId},
+                     {"timestamp", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss")},
+                     {"materials", managedMaterials.Select(m => m.name).ToArray()}
+                 };
+                 
+                 string checkpointPath = $"Checkpoint_{sessionId}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.json";
+                 string jsonData = JsonUtility.ToJson(checkpointData, true);
+                 System.IO.File.WriteAllText(checkpointPath, jsonData);
+                 
+                 // バックアップファイルの管理
+                 backupFiles.Add(checkpointPath);
+                 if (backupFiles.Count > backupRotationCount)
+                 {
+                     var oldestBackup = backupFiles[0];
+                     if (System.IO.File.Exists(oldestBackup))
+                     {
+                         System.IO.File.Delete(oldestBackup);
+                     }
+                     backupFiles.RemoveAt(0);
+                 }
+                 
+                 lastCheckpoint = DateTime.Now;
+                 Debug.Log($"[Emergency Protection] Checkpoint created: {checkpointPath}");
+             }
+             catch (Exception ex)
+             {
+                 Debug.LogError($"[Emergency Protection] Failed to create checkpoint: {ex.Message}");
+             }
+         }
+

+         /// lilToonのバージョンを自動検出
          /// </summary>
          public void DetectLilToonVersion()

+ float3 SampleVRCLightVolumes(float3 worldPos)
+ {
+     #if defined(VRC_LIGHT_VOLUMES_MOBILE)
+         // モバイル向け簡易版
+         float3 lightVolumeColor = float3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
+         lightVolumeColor *= _VRCLightVolumeTint.rgb * _VRCLightVolumeIntensity;
+         return lightVolumeColor;
+     #else
+         // フル機能版 - ピクセル単位計算
+         float3 lightVolumeColor = SampleVRCLightVolumesInternal(worldPos);
+         lightVolumeColor *= _VRCLightVolumeTint.rgb * _VRCLightVolumeIntensity;
+         return lightVolumeColor;
+     #endif
+ }
+ ```

+ ### 2. 電源断保護機能実装

+ #### 自動チェックポイント機能
+ ```csharp
+ // 電源断保護機能設定
+ [Header("Emergency Power Protection")]
+ public bool emergencySaveEnabled = true;
+ public float autoCheckpointInterval = 300f; // 5分間隔
+ public int backupRotationCount = 10; // 最大10個のバックアップ
+ 
+ // 定期チェックポイントの作成
+ private void CreateCheckpoint()
+ {
+     if (!emergencySaveEnabled) return;
+     
+     var checkpointData = new Dictionary<string, object>
+     {
+         {"sessionId", sessionId},
+         {"timestamp", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss")},
+         {"materials", managedMaterials.Select(m => m.name).ToArray()}
+     };
+     
+     string checkpointPath = $"Checkpoint_{sessionId}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.json";
+     System.IO.File.WriteAllText(checkpointPath, JsonUtility.ToJson(checkpointData, true));
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### 緊急保存機能
+ ```csharp
+ // アプリケーション終了時の処理
+ private void OnApplicationQuitting()
+ {
+     CreateEmergencyBackup();
+ }
+ 
+ // 緊急バックアップの作成
+ private void CreateEmergencyBackup()
+ {
+     var backupData = new Dictionary<string, object>
+     {
+         {"sessionId", sessionId},
+         {"timestamp", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss")},
+         {"materials", managedMaterials.Select(m => m.name).ToArray()},
+         {"settings", new Dictionary<string, object>
+         {
+             {"emergencySaveEnabled", emergencySaveEnabled},
+             {"useVRCLightVolumes", useVRCLightVolumes},
+             {"vrclvIntensity", vrclvIntensity}
+         }}
+     };
+     
+     string backupPath = $"EmergencyBackup_{sessionId}_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.json";
+     System.IO.File.WriteAllText(backupPath, JsonUtility.ToJson(backupData, true));
+ }
+ ```

+ {
+     // ハッシュベースのオフセット生成
